title: Is GPT-4 Less Politically Biased than GPT-3.5? A Renewed Investigation of ChatGPT’s Political Biases

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the Political Compass Test 100 times per model (GPT-3.5 and GPT-4) and per assigned political role (default, libertarian-left, libertarian-right, authoritarian-left, authoritarian-right) to measure the models' alignment on economic (left-right) and social (authoritarian-libertarian) axes.
